scope: Relevant recovered chat evidence; reported historical model completion is not independently verified model acceptance.

reactor_family.reported_remaining_work: Reference shape detail and surface wear; package geometry, current revision and acceptance must be independently inspected after recovery.
reference_constraints: Use the main collider/containment ring centre, ellipse, tilt and orientation as the reference anchor before comparing props.
Keep established ring, camera and assembly positions fixed during shape refinements unless actual reference evidence requires correction.
Rebuild only machinery visible in the reference; no arbitrary ornament or random replacement equipment.
Prior reported canister counts are 2/3/5; inspect actual latest source before treating them as proven.

reactor_camera_and_previous_geometry.reported_v10_inspection_camera: Orthographic, original +X/-Y azimuth, 20 degrees elevation. This is reference-inspection evidence, not an automatically approved Factorio production camera.
reactor_camera_and_previous_geometry.footprint_authority: Historical reported sizes, superseding earlier 3/5/7 starting proposals; measure latest v14 package and intended prototype before freezing final sizes.
reactor_camera_and_previous_geometry.reported_model_details: Half-round radiators recessed into machinery-side housings; supported plasma conduits with elbows, collars and saddles; central emblems on containment-ring faces.

initial_reactor_proposal.authority: Initial proposals only; neither the 3/5/7 footprints nor direct fluid-fuel electricity proposal establish final recipes or completed integration. Current user scope includes the metallic-hydrogen-pellet chain.

pipe_model_review.constraint: Correct actual boiler/condenser 3D model sizing and pipe attachment geometry; do not alter a reference image as a substitute.

local_search.conclusion: No matching local bytes located in these roots. This does not prove the files are absent elsewhere or unavailable in Library.
